coder_notes: Basket trial: glioblastoma is named in the conditions and in the Dose Expansion Glioblastoma arm (registered label spells it 'Gliblastoma'). The glioblastoma cohort (Cohort C) has no EGFR/HER2 aberration requirement in the inclusion list, so the biomarker requirements are linked only to the dose-escalation and non-GBM expansion arms; the arm descriptions say expansion is 'characterized by HER2 or EGFR aberrations', which is ambiguous for the GBM arm. PK is plasma only. Pharmacodynamics is named in the summary without a described measurement, hence target engagement unclear.
